code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated INR, suggesting possible impaired oxygenation and coagulopathy. There is a relative neutropenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and eosinophilia, with markedly elevated ferritin, which may indicate inflammation or infection. Low total protein and low CO₂ may reflect metabolic or nutritional disturbances. Cardiac and liver markers are within normal limits. Findings are suggestive of a systemic inflammatory response; clinical correlation and further evaluation for underlying causes (e.g., infection, inflammation, hypoxia) are recommended.
